note: Help and guides, opened from the account menu. Short answers, written for the Northline team. Invented.

guides.title: Start your day with Today
guides.text: Today lists what needs you, most urgent first. Open a card to see what your Inhouse agent found and which tool it read. Some cards hold a fix you can approve in one click. The rest tell you what to do next.

guides.title: How approvals work
guides.text: Your Inhouse agent never spends money or messages a customer on its own. For a change it can make, like a Shopify tag or a Slack post, it shows the change and waits. Approve it here or in Slack, and you have 10 seconds to undo anything that has just gone out.

guides.title: Set up a routine
guides.text: Open a chat and say what you want and when. For example: every Monday at 7 AM, check which products have under 3 weeks of stock. Your Inhouse agent adds the job to Routines and shows the next run.

guides.title: Teach a rule
guides.text: Tell your Inhouse agent once, in a chat. For example: late means 2 days unshipped for wholesale orders. Your Inhouse agent shows the rule, an approver confirms it, and the rule is saved in Team memory.

guides.title: Connect another tool
guides.text: Go to Tools, find the tool under Add a tool and choose Ask to connect. Your Inhouse team does the connection, usually within one working day. The login stays in your own account.

guides.title: Keep an eye on spend
guides.text: Usage shows what your Inhouse agent cost this month, by person, job, model and tool. Admins set the monthly cap in Settings. At the cap, your Inhouse agent pauses chats, routines and jobs until next month or until an admin raises the cap. Waiting drafts can still be approved.
